From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: virtual account & remittance mapping

Hi Sophie — thanks for sending this over and for the packet. A few things from Redwood’s side to help map things correctly:

1) PO encoding: please place all PO numbers in the single remittance field using pipe separators and a short prefix. Example we ingest: "RDW|PO:12345|PO:12346|INV:2026-0098". Our AP parser looks for the RDW token then splits on "|PO:" to associate invoices to POs.

2) Character limits: the remittance field we ingest will accept up to ~160 characters; anything beyond that will be truncated at import. If you have long invoice notes, include only PO references in the primary remittance field and put longer text into invoice-level notes in the file we pull from your CSV.

3) Micro-deposit vs prenote: our payments team generally prefers a micro-deposit for initial activation of external virtual accounts since prenotes can delay first payments. If your bank can support micro-deposits, please confirm the approximate timing and the deposit reference you plan to use.

4) PO mapping in system: once the remittance string is in the expected format our system will auto-apply to open POs. If any invoice fails to apply, our AP team will route it to manual resolution and notify your payables inbox.

I’ve attached the filled vendor onboarding form (redwood_vendor_onboard_form_filled.pdf) — please confirm receipt. Also please send the expected micro-deposit reference when issued so we can verify.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Manager, Procurement 
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboard_form_filled.pdf

Hi Sophie — looping in a quick note from Finance Ops to clarify timing and validation steps.

- Micro-deposit timing: Our treasury partner typically posts micro-deposits within 48 hours of initiation but bank cutoffs can vary. Please ask First Cooperative to label the deposit reference as "RDW-MD-XXXX" (we’ll use the Xs for the unique code).
- VA specifics: If you’re using a vendor-specific virtual account, we will accept remits in the single free-text field as Lauren outlined. However, for any invoices that reference more than 6 PO numbers we will ask for a CSV upload to avoid mis-parsing.
- Test invoice: If possible, please send one test invoice (sample CSV or single PDF invoice) after the micro-deposit posts so we can validate the full end-to-end flow.

Thanks — we’ll standby to verify once the deposit reference is shared.

—Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
